mfa_coverage_privileged_users.scope: Enabled user accounts in Domain Admins, Server Admins or Workstation Admins (service accounts excluded: MFA is N/A)

findings.description: Post-EHR-migration service account; no current function identified
conditions: Description shows no current owner or function: Post-EHR-migration service account; no current function identified
remediation: Remove the account from Domain Admins.
Rotate the password and record the change ticket.
If the account has no current function, disable it, keep it disabled for 30 days, then delete it.
If the function is still needed, move it to a scoped group or a Vault dynamic credential with a short TTL.
Verify the dependent job still runs and record the result.

findings.category: Standing Domain Admin on named account
conditions: Active, MFA enrolled; Domain Admin rights are held permanently on the same account used for daily work

Remove Domain Admins from the daily account.
Move Domain Admin use to JIT elevation with approval and logging.
